body.name: perfect-matching handle for singular weighted Gaussian transport
body.construction: Represent the balanced three-vector \((a_{gb,1},a_{gb,2},V_{gb}/\sigma_b)\) by a uniform random perfect matching followed by independent pair orientations; target a history-uniform covariance-range comparison through smooth Lindeberg replacement, covariance interpolation, fourth-moment truncation, and a conditional characteristic-function augmentation for \(U_b\).
